value: More of the old tongue, carved where the ground climbs clear of the mire. Speak it, and the swamp answers back.
Muddish runs slow and deep, as the marsh does. Sit a while. Read. The first words will come to you.
The shape of Muddish speech — how its words are ordered and strung. The hermit keeps to it still.
Crossroads. North to the peaks, west to the wood, east to the dunes, south to the mire.
Desert. Water is scarce — fill skins before crossing.
Forest path. Mind the roots, mind the wolves.
The highlands. Drier ground and a long view.
The mountains rise sharp and cold ahead. Bring rope.
Mudflats. Test each step — the mire swallows the careless.
Swampland. Stay on the high ground after dusk.
Village ahead. Trade, rest, and ask after the road.
Vyeshal is difficult to read. But study, my friend, and you will learn it.
